SELECT SEQ_EXECUTION_BATCH.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO EXECUTION_BATCH ( BATCH_ID, REQUEST_ID, INITIATED_BY, TRIGGER_TYPE, BATCH_TYPE, BATCH_STATUS, REQUESTED_AT ) VALUES ( #{batchId}, #{requestId}, #{initiatedBy}, #{triggerType}, #{batchType}, #{batchStatus}, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT REQUEST_ID, REQUEST_STATUS, APPROVAL_STATUS FROM QUERY_REQUEST WHERE REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND REQUEST_TYPE = 'SELECT' FOR UPDATE
SELECT QUERY_ID FROM QUERY_ITEM WHERE REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} ORDER BY QUERY_ORDER, QUERY_ID
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM USERS U JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON D.DEPT_ID = U.DEPT_ID WHERE U.USER_ID = #{userId} AND U.ENABLED = 'Y' AND D.DEPT_NAME = 'DB팀' ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM DUAL
SELECT BATCH_ID, REQUEST_ID, INITIATED_BY, BATCH_TYPE, BATCH_STATUS FROM EXECUTION_BATCH WHERE BATCH_ID = #{batchId}

SELECT E.EXECUTION_ID, E.BATCH_ID, E.QUERY_ID, E.STATUS FROM QUERY_EXECUTION E JOIN EXECUTION_BATCH B ON B.BATCH_ID = E.BATCH_ID JOIN QUERY_ITEM I ON I.QUERY_ID = E.QUERY_ID AND I.REQUEST_ID = B.REQUEST_ID WHERE E.BATCH_ID = #{batchId} ORDER BY I.QUERY_ORDER, I.QUERY_ID, E.EXECUTION_ID

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM USERS U JOIN USER_ROLE UR ON UR.USER_ID = U.USER_ID JOIN ROLE R ON R.ROLE_ID = UR.ROLE_ID WHERE U.USER_ID = #{userId} AND U.ENABLED = 'Y' AND R.ROLE_CODE = 'DB_APPROVER' ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM DUAL
mapper.update: UPDATE EXECUTION_BATCH SET BATCH_STATUS = 'RUNNING', INITIATED_BY = #{userId}, FINISHED_AT = NULL WHERE BATCH_ID = #{batchId} AND BATCH_STATUS = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT B.BATCH_ID, B.REQUEST_ID, B.BATCH_STATUS, Q.REQUEST_STATUS, B.FINISHED_AT, COUNT(E.EXECUTION_ID) AS TOTAL_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN E.STATUS = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS PENDING_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN E.STATUS = 'RUNNING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS RUNNING_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN E.STATUS = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SUCCESS_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN E.STATUS = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FAILURE_COUNT FROM EXECUTION_BATCH B JOIN QUERY_REQUEST Q ON Q.REQUEST_ID = B.REQUEST_ID LEFT JOIN QUERY_EXECUTION E ON E.BATCH_ID = B.BATCH_ID WHERE B.BATCH_ID = #{batchId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM USERS U WHERE U.USER_ID = #{actorId} AND U.ENABLED = 'Y' AND ( Q.DRAFTER_ID = U.USER_ID OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM USER_ROLE UR JOIN ROLE R ON R.ROLE_ID = UR.ROLE_ID WHERE UR.USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND R.ROLE_CODE = 'DB_APPROVER' ) ) ) GROUP BY B.BATCH_ID, B.REQUEST_ID, B.BATCH_STATUS, Q.REQUEST_STATUS, B.FINISHED_AT
